data.turoyo: Əmmi: "Qay ksuxrət u tarʕo?" Zayiʕi. Omər: "ʕAde yo gabayna, kul d korəx u maǧləs, kmaḥəḏina u tarʕo."
data.translation: "Wesshalb verriegelst du die Türe?" fragten sie, denn sie fürchteten sich. "Das ist so Gewohnheit bei uns", antwortete er, "jedesmal wenn Audienz ist, schliessen wir die Türe zu."

rationale: Fill Infectum 1 with 1pl customary door closing and a complete explanatory frame.

data.turoyo: Aṯən kulle lu ǧeməʕ, maḥəḏle u tarʕo. Əmmi: "Qay kmaḥiḏət u tarʕo?" Omər: "D lo nəfqo i ṣluṯo larwal, gunah yo."
data.translation: Als sie so alle in die Moschee gekommen waren, verschloss er die Türe. "Wesshalb verschliessest du die Türe?" fragten sie. "Damit das Gebet nicht hinausgeht, das wäre Sünde."

rationale: Fill Preterit 1 with a distinct mosque scene and the stated reason for closing the door; same lexical meaning.

summary: All new finite tokens have active III morphology and an overt door object. The 1pl Infectum custom statement contrasts with individual Preterit closing events without changing lexical meaning.
maḥiḏo at 24/158 is already an inherited Detransitive Part. Pass., presenting the gate's closed state. It is not a new form or citation; the entry lacks an explicit numbered Detransitive sense list.
The bodily act of closing is used in church, mosque and court settings. The setting and reason for closure do not establish a specialized idiom or numbered sense.

Jan 2.35/5573 distinguishes the Turoyo frame Kit bu kṯowo komər from the quoted passage B ṣəbyon ḥoṯe no, b ṣəbyon toyəb no ʕəlṯo aḥeḏ no daš šbon ṣoṭo no. The parallel predicates with no and explicitly cited-book setting support the reader’s identification as Syriac. This is evidence of literary quotation in modern prose, not evidence that Turoyo has acquired I “take/seize”.

Source-language lexical observation only: ʕəlṯo aḥeḏ no has a fronted excuse/reason noun with aḥeḏ no. The supplied project machine translation reads “I seize an excuse: Satan led me astray.” That English is not an edition translation, and it does not establish the exact source, a Turoyo object-coding rule, or a native fixed Idiomatic phrase.

No round-2 stem, sense, form box or example is proposed. Existing III.1 verschliessen and the round-1 door-closing examples stand; no relation between the quoted I sense and local III closing is asserted beyond the assigned root filing.
